gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Spaced-out and glossy. Stentiga skims along on strokes that never change weight, while Noto Sans Tangsa keeps its round letters wide open and its ascenders short.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-tc: Stentiga lays out wide-spaced letters with crossbars as heavy as the stems, a luxurious, stretched-out look. And Noto Sans TC counters with generous openings in its a, e and s, curves flaring outward.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Crossbars as heavy as the stems give Stentiga horizontals that never thin out, with spaced-out letters on top. Noto Sans Telugu keeps its counters connected to the outside, with a high midline.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-thai: Refined and stretched out. Noto Sans Thai follows with puffed, glass-bead lowercase and open rounds, so a full page of it would feel soft and easygoing.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-thai-lo: Stentiga has a rope-like uniformity in every stem, bowl and tail, spaced wide for a luxurious feel. Noto Sans Thai Looped brings tall, bold-looking lowercase with spacious gaps at its curve ends.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-tifinag: Luxurious, stretched and cable-like. Noto Sans Tifinagh fills each line with rounded, open bowls that look inflated, so a long page of it feels clean and unhurried.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Stentiga cuts every line at one depth, like an engraver's tool, with wide spacing. Noto Sans Tirhuta, by contrast, offers a dominant x-height and terminals cut back to leave large gaps.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-ugariti: Stentiga draws its spaced-out letters like toothpaste squeezed in a single steady line, refined and luxurious. Noto Sans Ugaritic stays close to cap height, mouths open like unjoined chalk arcs.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-vai: Stentiga gives every letterform a pipe-cleaner feel, stretched out with doorway-wide openings. Noto Sans Vai makes words read as solid blocks, with generous space between curve ends and stems.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-vithkuq: Stentiga never tapers where strokes meet or end, and its spaced-out letters have a luxurious look. Noto Sans Vithkuqi keeps open throats and a minimal cap step, so long reading flows.
